summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Ltd, a foreign private issuer, to disclose a Notice of Meeting and Record Date for an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for August 10, 2026. The filing provides only routine meeting logistics and exhibits; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change is described. As a standard meeting notice, it does not constitute a special situation.
